name: ab_multiline_block
description: A/B: multi-line block in drawer — stack() split across lines merges, plays, and highlights correctly
script: strudel ref stack(note("c4 e4 g4 c5"),note("c2 ~ c2 ~")) cps=0.5
announce REF: stack(melody, bass) — single line
# Ours: same stack() split across drawer lines via | separator
# The drawer should detect unclosed parens and merge into one block
announce OURS: stack(melody, bass) — multi-line block
strudel edit stack(|  note("c4 e4 g4 c5"),|  note("c2 ~ c2 ~")|) cps=0.5
